mcqs.q: What does a 'large scale' map mean?
options: The DTM only applies to countries with more than 50 million people.
Large scale means the map is physically big.
A large-scale map shows a large area.
A large-scale map covers a small area in high detail (e.g. 1:25,000 OS map of one town); a small-scale map covers a large area in less detail (e.g. 1:1,000,000 world atlas).

mcqs.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: The strengthening of the natural greenhouse effect by human activities (mainly burning fossil fuels) which add CO2 and other gases to the atmosphere.
The DTM only applies to countries with more than 50 million people.
The greenhouse effect is entirely man-made and harmful.
It is the hole in the ozone layer letting in more sun.

mcqs.q: Why is the Demographic Transition Model criticised for not applying to all countries?
options: The DTM only applies to countries with more than 50 million people.
All countries follow the five stages of the DTM in order.
Large scale means the map is physically big.

It was based on European industrialisation. LICs today face different conditions: imported medicine without industrialisation, cultural factors, gender inequality and globalised economies — not all follow the same path.
